name: Aerospace Manufacturing and Quality
summary: How airframes, engines and rockets are actually made: machining, forming, joining, composites fabrication, additive manufacturing and inspection.

topics.name: Machining of aerospace alloys and large monolithic parts
Sheet metal forming, spin forming and chemical milling
Joining: riveting, welding (including friction-stir welding), brazing and bonding
Composite fabrication: prepreg layup, autoclave, out-of-autoclave, filament winding, automated fibre placement
Additive manufacturing of engine and rocket components
Non-destructive evaluation: ultrasonic, X-ray/CT, eddy current, dye penetrant
Quality systems: AS9100, first-article inspection, traceability
Cleanliness and contamination control for propulsion and space hardware
Production rate, cost and supply chain
